query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage Salesforce leads, contacts, campaign membership, campaign attendance statuses, a campaign-based static list, and MQL lead activity reporting.
query_ground_truth.query: add a contact to a Salesforce campaign and update their attendance status
query_ground_truth.rationale: Adding a contact to a campaign directly corresponds to managing campaign membership and attendance statuses.

request.query: add a contact to a Salesforce campaign and update their attendance status

results.use_case: add a contact to a Salesforce campaign and update their attendance status
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if group/list field or allowed values uncertain)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the Contact field API name/type (e.g., multipicklist) using SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT (avoid schema mismatch).
[Required (if Contact.Id unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Locate target contacts using SALESFORCE_SEARCH_CONTACTS or SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (collect Contact.Id).
[Required] [Step]: Read current group/list field values for targets using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (select Id + field) to enable safe read-modify-write.
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm whether to append/remove vs overwrite, and whether removing the last value should clear the field (blank) before updating.
[Required] [Step]: Write bulk updates using SALESFORCE_SOBJECT_ROWS_UPDATE (send sobject_api_name, record_id, and only changed fields; preserve existing semicolon-delimited values when merging).
[Optional (if bulk update fails validation or for very small batches)] [Fallback]: Apply the same “only changed fields” update using SALESFORCE_UPDATE_CONTACT.
[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Re-read a sample using SALESFORCE_GET_CONTACT (or SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY) to confirm final group/list values.
[Optional (if memberships are modeled as Campaign membership)] [Next Step]: Add contacts to the campaign using SALESFORCE_ADD_CONTACT_TO_CAMPAIGN.
known_pitfalls: [SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] INVALID_FIELD occurs if the field API name is wrong; confirm via SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Multipicklist memberships are semicolon-delimited strings; failing to split/merge/join can overwrite existing values.
[SALESFORCE_SOBJECT_ROWS_UPDATE] Validation can fail if sobject_api_name is omitted; always include it with record_id and fields.
[SALESFORCE_UPDATE_CONTACT] Successful updates may return 204/no body or {}; verify via SALESFORCE_GET_CONTACT or SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY.
[SALESFORCE_SOBJECT_ROWS_UPDATE] Writing an empty string can clear a multipicklist; ensure this matches the desired “remove last value” behavior.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Salesforce is a leading CRM platform integrating sales, service, marketing, and analytics to build customer relationships and drive business growth
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=salesforce. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="salesforce") to create a connection BEFORE executing any salesforce tools.

SALESFORCE_SOBJECT_ROWS_UPDATE.description: Tool to update specific fields in an existing Salesforce sObject record. Use when you need to modify one or more fields in a record without affecting other fields.

fields.description: Dictionary of field name/value pairs to update. Only include fields that need to be updated. Field names must match the API names of the sObject fields (e.g., 'Phone', 'Name', 'CustomField__c'). Field names are case-sensitive.

record_id.description: The unique 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID of the record to update.

sobject_api_name.description: The API name of the Salesforce object type to update (e.g., Account, Contact, Opportunity, CustomObject__c). Case-sensitive.

SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY.description: Executes a SOQL query against Salesforce data. Returns records matching the query with pagination support.

examples: SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE CreatedDate > 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
SELECT Name, (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts) FROM Account
SELECT COUNT() FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'New'
SELECT COUNT(Id), StageName FROM Opportunity GROUP BY StageName
SELECT Id, Name FROM Opportunity ORDER BY Amount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Name FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'O\'Brien'
SELECT Id, Name, Description FROM Account LIMIT 10
query.description: SOQL query to execute. Must start with SELECT. Field names must match object schema exactly — use SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT for unfamiliar objects. ALIASES: No 'AS' keyword (use 'SUM(Amount) TotalSales' NOT 'SUM(Amount) AS TotalSales'). AGGREGATES: Without GROUP BY, ORDER BY/LIMIT not allowed (single-row result). COUNT() SYNTAX: Bare COUNT() only valid alone. With GROUP BY or other fields, must specify field: COUNT(Id) or COUNT(fieldName). Example: 'SELECT COUNT(Id), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status' NOT 'SELECT COUNT(), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status'. NON-GROUPABLE: Long text, rich text, encrypted text, compound address/location fields. NON-FILTERABLE: Long text area, rich text, encrypted text, multi-select picklists, blob fields CANNOT be in WHERE. FIELDS(ALL)/FIELDS(CUSTOM) require LIMIT ≤200. ID values need single quotes. Apostrophes use backslash: 'O\'Brien'.

SALESFORCE_SEARCH_CONTACTS.description: Search Salesforce Contact records (not Leads — use SALESFORCE_SEARCH_LEADS for those) using name, email, phone, account, or title. All parameters support partial/fuzzy matching, so results may include unrelated records; post-filter client-side for exact matches. Partial matches and common names can return multiple contacts — always confirm the correct contact by its 18-character Id before passing to write operations like SALESFORCE_LOG_CALL or SALESFORCE_CREATE_TASK. A response with totalSize=0 is a valid 'not found' outcome. Provide at least one search criterion; omitting all returns a broad, slow result set. Returned Ids are 18-character strings and must be used as-is in downstream tools.

name.description: Search by contact name (first name, last name, or full name). Supports partial matches.

email.description: Search by email address. Supports partial matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return. Maximum allowed is 2000; when totalSize exceeds limit, paginate to retrieve full results.

phone.description: Search by phone number. Supports partial matches.

title.description: Search by job title. Supports partial matches.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Contact fields to retrieve. Custom and non-default fields are excluded unless explicitly listed here.

account_name.description: Search by associated account name. Supports partial matches.
